kpis.name: Manual Processing Hours Saved (Monthly)
kpis.definition: Total staff hours per month removed from a manual process as a direct result of the initiative.

kpis.name: Employee Productivity & Effort Score
kpis.definition: Survey-based score measuring staff perception of effort and productivity for the impacted workflow.

kpis.name: Process Cycle Time Reduction
kpis.definition: End-to-end time to complete the impacted workflow, comparing pre- and post-implementation states.
kpis.calculation: Avg(New Process Time) - Avg(Old Process Time)

kpis.name: Average Resolution Time
kpis.definition: Mean time from service request submission to resolution / closure.

kpis.name: Average Response Time
kpis.definition: Mean time from service request submission to first meaningful response from the City.

kpis.name: Complaint Reduction Rate
kpis.definition: Year-over-year percentage reduction in formal complaints related to the impacted service.

kpis.name: Customer Satisfaction Score
kpis.definition: Composite satisfaction score combining a numeric rating with qualitative feedback themes from post-service surveys.
kpis.calculation: Mean(satisfaction_score) plus thematic coding of free-text comments

kpis.name: Ease of Interaction Index
kpis.definition: Qualitative measure of how easy it was for the resident or business to interact with the City for this service.
kpis.calculation: Weighted index of effort indicators (steps required, time taken, repeat contacts, perceived ease)

kpis.name: First-Contact Resolution Rate
kpis.definition: Percentage of inquiries fully resolved at first point of contact, without escalation or callback.

kpis.name: Citizen Satisfaction (CSAT) — generic
kpis.definition: Citizen-reported satisfaction with the service interaction or outcome (generic CSAT — see Customer Satisfaction Score for the canonical CoO metric).

kpis.name: Operating Cost Reduction
kpis.definition: Year-over-year reduction in operating expenditure on the impacted program or service.

kpis.name: Vendor / Procurement Spend Reduction
kpis.definition: Reduction in third-party / vendor spend attributable to the initiative (in-sourcing, consolidation, automation).

kpis.name: Compliance / Audit Finding Reduction
kpis.definition: Reduction in the number or severity of audit / compliance findings against the impacted process.

kpis.name: Operational Incident Rate
kpis.definition: Rate of operational incidents (security, safety, service outage) per unit time for the impacted area.

kpis.name: Net Revenue Growth
kpis.definition: Net new non-tax revenue generated by the initiative (gross revenue minus incremental cost-to-serve).

kpis.name: Digital Channel Adoption Rate
kpis.definition: Share of citizen interactions completed via digital channels versus phone or in-person.

kpis.name: Engagement Reach
kpis.definition: Unique residents/stakeholders meaningfully engaged through the initiative (consultation, programming, services).

kpis.name: Equity of Access Index
kpis.definition: Composite measure of how equitably the service reaches priority neighbourhoods and populations.
kpis.calculation: Weighted index of access metrics across priority groups
